data.title: 新条茜 · 海边的怪兽沙堡
data.description: 【城市海滨沙滩·正午】茜穿着淡紫泳装蹲在沙堡旁，用贝壳给一只小怪兽沙雕做眼睛；她完成后将承托作品的小平木板轻推向镜头，红色眼睛里映着阳光和海水，笑容比任何社交场合都更自然。
data.location: quiet city beach away from the crowds
data.action: 沙滩上用贝壳给怪兽沙雕装眼睛，完成后把承托作品的小平木板轻推向镜头自然微笑
data.lighting: strong noon sun with warm sand bounce
data.mood: 把孤独做成可以分享的沙堡
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou crouches beside her little monster sand sculpture, placing shells for its eyes before gently sliding the supporting board toward the viewer. Her white sun shirt covers a lavender swimsuit, shell clips keeping her hair back. The horizontal medium view shows sandcastle edges and sea beyond her natural smile. Strong noon sunlight catches shell ridges and carved sand, while warm sand bounce lights the lower face and short shadows define the creature's shape.
